user.title: Claude subscription
user.description:
1. Open this link and sign in with your Claude account:
{url}

2. After confirming, the page shows a code. Copy all of it (including the part after #) and paste it below.

This is a separate login – Claude Code on your computer is not affected. Note: Anthropic offers no official interface for subscription data; this may change at any time.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Access has expired or was revoked. Continue to sign in again.

error.invalid_code: Code invalid or expired. Please open the new link and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. See log for details.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests – please try again in a few minutes.

data_description.scan_interval: Keep it at 5 minutes or more – the endpoint blocks otherwise.
